address: La Cour des Consuls, 46 rue des Couteliers, Toulouse, 31000, France
bio: Le Cénacle has a plush, elegant atmosphere (superb 16C sculpted fireplace, a Caravaggio print, exposed beams). The chef takes pride in forging long-lasting partnerships with good regional producers: organic vegetables from Gers, lamb from Béarn, line-caught fish. Inventive cuisine with a Mediterranean flavour, and good value for money at lunchtime....
